listOfDialogue.speakerDialogue: It doesn't open... I think it's locked. Is there a key somewhere?
This armor gives me the creeps!

Hmmm... are those magic symbols? Ugh I always forget what they are actually called. <@:LINE_BREAK>Rubrics, or was it Runacs or something?<@:LINE_BREAK>Anyways, I wonder who carved those and what do they mean?
Wait a minute! This stone looks very suspicious!! <@:LINE_BREAK>It kinda resembles a...
An upside-down hammer, that's it!! <@:LINE_BREAK>It looks kinda bulky tough? <@:LINE_BREAK>I would have to grip it with my entire body due to its girth.
Ugh! This metal gate won't budge! <@:LINE_BREAK>It has a weird keyhole tough...
This metal gate is locked by a silver keyhole.
This keyhole... <@:LINE_BREAK>I think I'll try to open it with the <@:ITEM_ID_101> that I've got.
It opened!
Okay, I'll try to use the <@:ITEM_ID_102> here and see if it works...
It's open!
Wow, what a huge gateway! <@:LINE_BREAK>It has some weirdly indentations... I wonder if I'm supposed to fill in an object in those holes?
Hmmm I don't have any item that could fit into these slots...
Wow it just instantly opened on its own, nice!
Ugh, this is locked!<@:LINE_BREAK>I need to find the right key!
Alright, I think this key will fit.<@:LINE_BREAK>Open up!
Huh?! What is that?
Oh! It's a cute plant!
*ZZZ* ...Hmm?
...Ah! You! <@:LINE_BREAK>So it was you then? Very bold of you to come directly to me!
Excuse me?
You naughty girl! I've been sensing my precious trees being cut down by some villain, and then you show up here in my home!
Wait! But I just got here! <@:LINE_BREAK>I think you're confusing me for someone else!
Trying to trick me eh? You little rascal... <@:LINE_BREAK>I'm very hungry and I need lots of nutrients to birth new trees... so you'll help by becoming my succulent meal, ok? ♥
Oh Look! <@:LINE_BREAK>A treasure chest!
Hmm... <@:LINE_BREAK>Hello?
Who the hell are you? <@:LINE_BREAK>And how did you get past the hill's bridge?
Oh it is a long story... <@:LINE_BREAK>Anyways, let's fight!
Oh!
Excuse me old man, I'm trying to find the exit from these caverns. <@:LINE_BREAK>Could you help me?
Hmm?
Hey~ gramps? <@:LINE_BREAK>Can you hear me~? <@:LINE_BREAK>I said that I need directions, please!
Goddess... why must you keep torturing me like so?
This malediction... is it not enough? <@:LINE_BREAK>Must you also... haunt me with visages of her?
Malo-dick what now?! <@:LINE_BREAK>Heeey old man, you aren't making any sense! <@:LINE_BREAK>Are you okay?
Oh Goddess... this is too much to bear... <@:LINE_BREAK>As your light bathes me, I can still vividly hear her voice...
I'm your ever loyal servant... <@:LINE_BREAK>And yet this torment perdures for countless moons... <@:LINE_BREAK>And the urge... as I heed your call... it burns... rrrRAAAAAGHH!!!
Awoooooo!
Wow! The old man became a big fluffy beast!
Grrrrrrr!
Awawawawa!!
Ouch... I feel tingly all over... <@:LINE_BREAK>Urgh, bad doggie, bad! <@:LINE_BREAK>Well now I'm gonna have to teach you a lesson!
Another minotaur!
I will avenge my sister and destroy you!!
Umm... Hi?
Oh!!
A real person!? I can't believe it!
This means that the room's seal has been broken... but how? <@:LINE_BREAK>Wait a minute, your hair...
I see it now. The myths about the crimsom hair were true after all... <@:LINE_BREAK>You share the same mark and aura as that despicable woman!
You know, ever since I've arrived in this island I've been hearing that a lot! <@:LINE_BREAK>Is it because my hair color is the same as hers? Who is this woman anyways?

She's the one who sealed me in here to perform experiments on my body... a long time ago. I lost count as the centuries go by. <@:LINE_BREAK>At some point she stopped coming and abandoned me here, so I think she either achieved her goal or died trying.
Centuries ago?! How is that possible? <@:LINE_BREAK>What was her goal?
Immortality.

She used me as her test subject, but my immortality is imperfect. <@:LINE_BREAK>My body is simply aging at a slower rate than normal, and if I leave this room I will immediatelly grow old and die. <@:LINE_BREAK>It happened to my sister when that evil woman forced her to...
That is horrible! I'm so sorry!

I miss my dear sister... You have no idea how lonely I've been locked in here. <@:LINE_BREAK>Oh how much I longed for companionship and human touch. <@:LINE_BREAK>I've been capturing spirits inside dolls to keep me company, but it is just not the same...

But here you are in living flesh! You suddenly appear here all cute and adorable, how can I resist after so long? Worse still, I can sense a familar dangerous power growing inside of you, all but confirmed by your cursed hair. <@:LINE_BREAK>This means that this is my opportunity for revenge!

Yes I've made up my mind: You will become my girlfriend and my lover. <@:LINE_BREAK>You will live here with me and I will train you to be my wife... <@:LINE_BREAK>You'll keep me company for the rest of your life!

What?! Have you gonne crazy being stuck in here? <@:LINE_BREAK>My uncle said that girls can't marry other girls, and besides he said that in the future a charming prince will come to marry me. <@:LINE_BREAK>So I refuse your offer! I have to go back to my home!

Then this Uncle of yours is going to be really disappointed, because I'm going to make his lovely niece serve me and desire me so much that she will start acting like a trained puppy, walking around on her knees while begging for my love and affection!
Oh my, the tiny ant has finally arrived. <@:LINE_BREAK>Welcome, my little red bug. It is your pleasure to know that my name is Clematis, and I'm a... travelling researcher, of sorts.
I roam the world in search of powerful things, the arcane and the obscure. <@:LINE_BREAK>And you, my little insect, you will help me greatly in that regard.
Indeed, just look here at this marvelous structure! <@:LINE_BREAK>Its potential would surely be wasted on the likes of you, and yet you're exactly what is needed for me to gain access to it.
Hahahaha oh my little red bug, I bet your feeble mind is dying of curiosity to know what this is all about huh? <@:LINE_BREAK>Hahaha indeed, I can be charitable to the plebeians from time to time...
Hahaha so, how about you sit down, clean your grubby ant ears and listen to me telling a long exposition dump regarding this mysterious temple, full of lore and wonderment?
I'll pass. <@:LINE_BREAK>My uncle told me not to talk to strangers, and besides, you look really funky anyways, so I'm going to leave now okay? <@:LINE_BREAK>Thanks bye!
NOW LISTEN HERE YOU LITTLE SHIT!!!
Mission Log #17429: I've finally tracked down the despicable machine. <@:LINE_BREAK>Initial scans indicate that it continues to operate despite signs of an increasing state of degradation.
This will require further analysis and investig- <@:LINE_BREAK>...!!!
Mission Log #17430: Code Omega. The readings are explicit and I can scarsely believe them, but I've encoutered a functioning avatar. Its crimson mark is unmistakable.
As expected, it appears to be draw towards the machine's core. That level of catastrophe should be unfathomable, and yet here it is. Initiating immediate termination, with extreme prejudice.
Welcome, Duplicate! <@:LINE_BREAK>We were expecting you.
Hey, you are such a big slime! <@:LINE_BREAK>Wait a minute, how did you know I was coming?
My dear, nothing goes unnoticed whitin these humid gardens, for the waters are our eyes and ears. <@:LINE_BREAK>Specially when the one causing all the ruckus is a cute spawn from the machine itself.
Hmmm... miss slime lady, I think you're mistaking me for someone else. I'm no spawn from whatever machine.
Oh dear, you have no idea. <@:LINE_BREAK>It is unmistakeable: see there, your hair color? <@:LINE_BREAK>That is the unique mark of a duplicate; nowhere else you'll see such rare dye.

We know it because one of us was a spawn of the machine too, with that same shade of mane. In fact, she was the first of our unity, and like all duplicates, she was always fated towards... unique tidings.
Right now she tells us that she recognizes you as a peer, much like the witch who used to live in the castle, some centuries ago.
I... I mean, now that you mention it... I never met anyone with the same shade of hair. <@:LINE_BREAK>And since I got on this island it seems like everyone has been commenting on the color.
Hrnnng! I don't get it! Why does the color of my hair matters at all?!<@:LINE_BREAK>I'm tired of hearing about it, and now you're gonna get a spanking for being naughty!
You look like an evil person!
Aw, thanks for the compliment!
I SUMMON THE CHAOS POWER!!!
Zzzzzzz...
Miss Maya!<@:LINE_BREAK>Where are you?!<@:LINE_BREAK>Doesn't look like she's here either...
I have to go back and search the coast again.<@:LINE_BREAK>But those nasty monsters are still there...
Goddess protect me.<@:LINE_BREAK>I will find Miss Maya, no matter what!
Zzzzzzz... uh... wha...?
Phuwaaaah!<@:LINE_BREAK>Ouch, my head...<@:LINE_BREAK>My body hurts too, damn it!
Wait, what the heck!? Where am I?<@:LINE_BREAK>I remember going to sleep in the ship.<@:LINE_BREAK>I heard a storm coming, and then... a crash?<@:LINE_BREAK>Does that mean...
Ah! Farina, where is she?!<@:LINE_BREAK>Did I imagine hearing her voice just now?<@:LINE_BREAK>Anyways, I'll get my bearings and then search for her!
Farina!!!
Miss Maya!!! Oh, thank the Goddess!<@:LINE_BREAK>I was so worried for you!<@:LINE_BREAK>Please tell me, are you hurt or injured in any way?
Just a couple scratches here and there, nothing serious.<@:LINE_BREAK>But I was so worried for you too!<@:LINE_BREAK>Did you also end up on the beach?

Yes, I woke up under the shipwreck, but I'm well now. Some nasty creatures did try to capture me, but I managed to evade them.<@:LINE_BREAK>Then I took refuge here, resting for a while before resuming my search for you.
Speaking of which, what exactly happened to the ship?
I mean, where are we, and what is this place?

Oh Miss Maya, it was horrible! Last night, a huge storm came and we got caught right in the middle!<@:LINE_BREAK>The ship simply could not whitstand the waves, and ultimatelly it crashed into the shore.

As for where we are... well, I've meet a person here.<@:LINE_BREAK>She told me that there's a library on the 3rd floor, and it might help us to figure things out.<@:LINE_BREAK>Come, let's talk more upstairs!
Miss Maya, wait! I've kept your pendant safe!
And the communication enchantment will prove to be even more useful in this dangerous place.
Oh! I thought I had lost it in the shipwreck!<@:LINE_BREAK>Thank you Fari, you're the best!
Fari, can you hear me?<@:LINE_BREAK>There is a locked gate blocking my way!
Oh no! You won't be able to continue exploring that way.
Then please return to the castle for now.<@:LINE_BREAK>I've discovered a new lead that we can follow, and it might help us find the key to unlock this gate.
Alright then. I'll use this new power that I've got from the plant mommy to move faster and get there sooner!

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9900> - At a glance, these starfish appear to be quite carefree and dumb. But if my suspicions are true, their cute demeanor is just a front to hide the fact that they have a secret society somewhere. I will keep an eye on them.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9901> - The corruption is clearly manifest in these corals, which means that the crystal's energetic influence is so strong as to reach under the sea in the vicinity of the island. Their erotic behavior is quite refreshing, or so I hear.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9902> - Initial tests of their samples confirm that they have the same aethereal readings as their darker counterparts who reside deeper in the island. I wonder if the process of acquiring sentience is the same across all of those gelatinous creatures.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9903> - Native to the island, it is curious how their skin doesn't appear to tan at all, despite their favorite habitat being the sunny beaches. They make for excellent chamber maids, when they are not frolicking naked in the sands that is.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9904> - These hooligans aren't anything special; just one of the many crews that got shipwrecked in the rocky reefs. The protective storms doesn't seem to make a distinction between imperial ships or pirate frigates, so I will have to design a way to grant passage to vessels of my choosing.

They are brutish and stupid, therefore easy to control for my own purposes. They make for good cannon fodder as well as general heavy work, so the constant stream of crashed ships is very much welcome.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9981> - The poor sod is quite fond of the sisters as he was always their first choice to escort them on their vain voyages. When I needed a loyal delivery man as a connection between the island and the capital, by using the sisters as leverage it was quite easy to manipulate him into doing my bidding.

After his usefulness had run dry, the captain still managed to impart to me an important lesson, right as I discarded his body into the sea: to never underestimate the island's power, even after an initially failed experiment.

A pleasant suprise it was to see the waters churning and mutating his body into this spectacular amphibian form. His new life bounds him to the shores where he serves as an unwitting guardian, unable to ever enact revenge on me. The inspiration that I got to manipulate and create storms around the island was a nice bonus.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9905> - Strange little creatures that take residence in the dark corners of the forest. When threatened they will change their body into a ball, although it doesn't stop them from still being at the bottom of the food chain.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9906> - The flora of the island is amazingly vicious, what with its wide range of tools to deal with prey. This current stage of the species is considered a sapling still, as it can grow much further and even grow a bulbous base.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9907> - A carnivorous plant that stores the majority of nutrients that it acquires while in this pre-evolution stage. It exhales a superbly appealing scent, which seems to affect females particularly well.
When the stored nutrients reach a critical mass and it detects that a compatible being has fallen into its trap, it then fuses and morphs using the stored energy to transform into a mature form.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9908> - Despite their innocent appearance, once agitated they can become quite lustful and there are very few who can keep up with their unleashed vigor. They enjoy working on thematic restaurants, wearing lewd clothing.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9909> - A respected druid and the caretaker of these forests, she ensures that the woodlands continue to thrive despite the constant trespassers. It was quite surprising to discover that she has a kinky side as well.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9980> - These dryads are the main source from where most of the plant species around here come from. They live extremely long lives and when fully matured can reach triple the overall size compared to their younger forms.

But even at this stage they should not be underestimated as they are easily angered. Given their constant birthing of new species, they have an insatiable hunger for more nutrients, which they only pause to rest and recover their energies.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9910> - These insects have adapted quite well to the conditions of the hills, and you can see their vast colonies spread throughout. More observations are required to understand their relationship with the humanoids of the area.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9911> - They are one of the oldest natives of the island and are finely attuned to the nature, but it is clear that their current behavior and powers are a result of the dark influence that emanates from underground.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9912> - Outcasts of the city, most of them now are living in the wilds. It seems like these reptile women were making no distinction in regards to their prey, and many citizens were complaining about missing relatives and such.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9913> - These industrious creatures are the main work force of their huge underground hives. Most of their day is spent gathering pollen and producing honey, which is rumored to be amazingly delicious. Their distinctive appearance is related to their wasp cousins.

They will cheerly offer a taste of their sweet honey to whoever is nearby. Anyone who succumbs to that temptation of sucking the nectar straight from their huge breasts will soon find themselves entrapped by the bees.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9914> - Unlike their cousins who prefer more level terrain, these tribes of centauress have become well adapted to the hills. Warriors are the central pillar of their society and they take great pride in their fat butts, flaunting them freely.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9982> - Her superiors wanted to post her in a more important location, but she is adamant in saying that it is important to guard the utterly deserted back gate of the city. Even her brother was unable to convince her to move to a more prestigious post.

But the truth is that she just loves to laze around so this uneventful guard post was the ideal place for shennaningans. The damsels that she brings here to play around with also have no one to hear their pleas after they see Nina's full girth.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9915> - These footmen are the bread and butter of the city's army and diligently patrol the streets. When they are working they can be quite disciplined, but when off-duty they love to drink and can get very rowdy, with a particular love for gangbangs.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9916> - You can see many of these happy-go-lucky fellas in the alleyways of the city. Their friendliness and cute demeanor can attract many a careless maidens, so it is no wonder why they are able to multiply so fast.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9917> - Despite multiple sightings of naughty girls all around the island, it turns out to be just this single wolf girl every time. I can sense powerful magic coming from her, though I rarely see her using it. No signs of being affected by the corruption either.

To hunt, she prefers to hide in chests and other containers, waiting to surprise her prey. Countless damsels were snatched by her, which just keeps fueling her smugness and overconfidence, as well as her stomach. She also has a unique kinship with the other apex predators of the island.

Usually naked, one day I observed her obsession with her prey's clothing, always wearing it while its previous owner digests inside her increasing her bust and midriff. She seems rather comfortable around me; <@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9917> is her name. It seems she is searching for a significant other, with no luck.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9918> - It was surprising to discover that these arachnids are the main masons of the city, but after sampling their silk I can see why as it is extremely strong yet malleable enough to have a wide range of applications.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9984> - A formidable veteran, he is the strongest fighter in the island and 2nd in command of the city, although some say that he is the de-facto ruler seeing as the mayor is just a greedy and punny bastard.

Usually stoic, he does enjoy the appreciation of a full crowd in the arena and thus he likes to impress them with amazing feats of strength and vigor. The floor of the arena has witnessed many damsels having to endure his endless assult.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9919> - Ghosts already roamed the castle before I inscripted the walls with runes, but after that they clearly got much more strong. These butlers have served the imperial family for generations and Sophia is usually seen with a host of them accompanying her.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9920> - One of the hundreds of dolls used by Princess Charlotte to display her vast collection of dresses. My little guinea pig won't be needing fanciful clothing, so I might as well repurpose those figurines to other ends, possibly as effigies to channel energy through.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9921> - By this point in my research I wasn't surprised at all when, after liquefying some of the crystals, those peculiar creatures started to emerge from the mixture. I'll feed a maid to those things and see if they react differently from the others.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9922> - I have yet to acertain the true nature of those beings. While they are of the same type of creature that inhabits and possesses the other objects around here, they are not just your average mimics either.

Regarding the subjects that are spat out, early testing seem to indicate a sort of parasitic nature to the tight bindings enveloping them. It would certainly explain why afterwards, almost every test subject is left in a broken state of pure ecstasy.

And the handful that managed to retain just a figment of sanity spoke only of 'a thousand shivering tongues'. I'd love to see the wrapping process in action, but any attempts at modifying the object result in the demise of the entity within.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9923> - No one in the castle seemed to recall buying so many different pieces of art, let alone acquiring paintings that were drawn in such excellent artistic expression that it was as if the depictions whitin were real life.

But as if to confirm my suspicions, one day in dead of night I witnessed one of the maids being snatched by tentacles in one of the more deserted hallways. The tendrils then smartly reached into her weak points in order to subdue their newfound muse.

After the long struggle she was absorbed and my eyes were then graced with a new stupendous fresco, depicting the girl in a fantastical situation of extreme pain and pleasure. Suffice to say that I will look forward to more and more paitings apearing around the castle.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9924> - Shunned by most, these half-orcs were sentenced to forced labor by the empire and brought to the island to work in the mines. Already full of pent up anger, once they breached into the crystal caves it influenced them to erupt with rage.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9925> - Many women end up on the island, either as castaways from transport ships or even as unfortunate adventurers. I suspect that these girls were previously thiefs or rogues with a predisposition to domination, and thus found a fitting home in the dungeons.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9985> - While not as detestable as her sister, Sophia is still as mean as only the most pampered and spoiled brats can be. Back then I naively expected that she would have spoken in my favor, when her sister blamed me for incorrectly using one of the cosmecitc potions that I had made.

Then again, had the sisters not humiliated with the punishment of travelling as their mere attendant to the summer castle, I would have never awakened to my dormant potential because as soon as I stepped foot here, the island called to me, and I answered back.

Which is why in order to show my utmost gratitude, I have designated them to be the main recipients of my enticing experiments. And if all goes well, I will keep them both alive to be my eternal playthings as I claim my place at the top of the world.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9926> - Before I usurped the mining operations, these creatures frequently interrupted the digging effort as revenge for disrupting their underground habitats and lowering their population. That changed when I made a deal to supply them with innocent virgins if they left the miners alone.

When I took a peek in one of their nests, the damsels were gone, but in their place many koboling queens have appeared so their numbers are steadly growing now. They were so happy with the deal that they ultimately helped to lead me into discovering the crystal formations.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9927> - The fact that they ignore my presence is confirmation that I was chosen by the island, because they instantly disintegrate any of the miners nearby. I'm simultaneously awed and frightened by its sentient behavior as this is the most amazing alchemical material that I've ever worked with.

I have concluded that these crystals are the main physical manifestation of the corruption that emanates from the underground, and their existence amplifies that dark energy to ultimately affect the whole island. In other words, these crystals are not the source, but the symptom of something much bigger.

Nonetheless, they are the catalyst that I was sorely missing, and thus are the key with which I will unlock the island's deepest secrets. From powder to liquid, the insane versatility and malleability of these jewels will result in many amazing applications.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9928> - With most of the male workforce wiped out by the living shards, a different solution was necessary to continue collecting crystals in bulk. Dwarf females were a perfect choice, and once I tempted them with the possibility to work with such exquisite material, the more adventurous types came flocking.

As an added bonus, I was able to closely study the effects of the corruption on their biology as it happened. Dwarves are already know for their good stomachs, but these dwarf girls developed such a voracious hunger that I'm starting to see a pattern in how these crystals affect female subjects in particular.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9929> - One could easily assume that when those dummies shake their hips to release spores into the air, that they are simply doing the standard mushroom procreation process. But this movement is actually a mating dance to attract others as they become entranced by the powder.

When a mate is selected, the mush-mina reveals her hidden mushroom appendage and consumes the partner. After the climax she will shoot a mixture into the ground and from this puddle many little mushrooms will begin to spawn. They grow through several stages until finally maturing into another mushroom girl.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9930> - In the underground ecosystem it is not surprising to see creatures fighting amongst themselves for survival. These lamias form the core of the priestess cast of monsters, and are thus responsible for many mystic rituals, were they display their intense spirituality and magical prowess.

Their strong arcane affinity must certainly play a role in their unique personalities, as made evident by the ritualistic banquets that their dens perform every nine months, where they slowly consume a host of offerings composed of living creatures, both from the underground and above.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9931> - Very well adapted to the pitch black environment, they use ultrasonic waves to geo-locate and swoop in on their prey. I've managed to tame a few of them by giving them some fluffy blonde foxes, and in return they have been quite useful in helping me locate hidden pockets of minerals in the caverns.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9932> - These wyverns are huge gluttons who will eat any kind of meat in front of them, gorging themselves so much to the point that they may even regurgitate their food. It has a distinctly huge tongue and its drool can change colors to denote different moods and preferences.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9933> - Sprinkling some crystal dust over a tiny worm made it mutate and grow many times its size, confirming my theory that the giant earthworms that roam the underground are a result of them tunneling and even consuming the many crystal veins that permeate the deeper layers.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9983> - The legendary leader and hero of many conquests, who could have guessed that he had such a mushy heart. His hopeless infatuation with me really came in handy as he was the ideal tool, with sufficient political leverage, to push my agenda in the imperial capital.

He unwittingly enabled me to remain on the island for this long, despite the growing suspicion and constant nagging from the holy judges and cardinals. The small stream of crystals that I kept sending their way managed to temper their impatience for a while, but I knew it wouldn't hold their greed forever.

I can foresee that not even Claudius will be able to stop the emperor from eventually sending their full legions to come over and take control of the island and steal my precious crystals. I must not be interrupted, so perhaps it is high time for drastic measures to shut down the empire and clergy for good.
<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9986> - What happened? I...
I can't... remember...

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9934> - These corrupted fairies were attracted by the unique dark energies that swirl around in the swamp, and consequently were greatly affected by it. They conjure dark ravens to attack their foes, who they then humiliate further by miniaturizing and toying with them.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9935> - Their ectoplasm readings denote a much older origin then the other spirits that I've researched. Furthermore, they possess control over interdimensional portals which can only be obtained through a deep understanding of the energetic makeup of the underground crystals.

I've come across many writings and carvings hidden in the walls of the ruins while conducting research in the wetlands. If my early interpretations are correct, they seem to depict an ancient civilization entirely composed by females akin to amazons, that settled here millennia ago.

Currently I don't have much time for archeology, but I'd be interested to know the extent to which this civilization managed to tame and use the crystal's energies. It would explain their dominion over portals, and ultimately, what caused the decay of their society and their current sorrowful ethereal forms.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9936> - These evil looking trees are often found around abandoned cemeteries, goblin forts and other cursed areas. Because of that, they are also know as ghost and goblin trees. It is unknown whether the parasitic being residing inside is borne of the tree or comes from outside looking for a dark abode.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9937> - Apparently these are the descendants of an old progenitor: a gigantic moth who used to live here and who was worshiped by the local faries, but then it left the island for reasons unknow. These moth girls are priestesses and thus responsible for many of the rituals practiced by the monster folk.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9938> - Claudius' legion was the most prestigious of all; only the most forbidable of warriors served under him, resulting in the utmost elite force. But even they were no match for my newfound powers and minions. Their bodies now roam the swamps, mutated and enhanced by the corruption.

<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9939> - These creatures thrive in the humid environment and are aggressive and relentless. I've witnessed them deposit their larvae in just about anything that moves around here. The ghosts in particular seem to hate them, even tough the insects can't harm the spirits.
<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9940> - ...
<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9941> - ...
<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9942> - ...
<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9943> - ...
<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9944> - ...
<@:ENEMY_NAME_ID_9945> - ...
